title: GPT generative pre-training approach
before: Many high-performing NLP systems depended heavily on supervised datasets for each task.
problem: Labeling enough data for every language task is expensive.
change: OpenAI's 2018 GPT-1 paper described generative pre-training on large text followed by discriminative fine-tuning, using a transformer decoder-style model.
whyItMattered: It popularized a recipe—pretrain then adapt—that scaled into later GPT generations and the broader LLM ecosystem.
enabled: Few-shot and instruction-tuned assistants used in software engineering workflows.
concreteExample: An engineer pastes an error log into an LLM chat to get debugging hypotheses—downstream of pretrain/finetune ideas.
caveat: Later models differ substantially in scale, data, and alignment methods; GPT-1 is an early milestone, not today's systems.
